name: LANKO 311 Bricklayers Plasticiser
paste:
LANKO® 311 BRICKLAYERS PLASTICISER: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: LANKO® 311 Bricklayers Plasticiser, May 2026, Version 01.02 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/x/lanko-311-bricklayersplasticiser.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide LANKO® 311 Bricklayers Plasticiser where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (May 2026, Version 01.02).
1.2 Product description. LANKO® 311 Bricklayers Plasticiser is a plasticising additive for use in bricklayer’s mortar and sand/cement mortars in general. It is designed to greatly improve the handling characteristics of mortars that it is added to. LANKO® 311 Bricklayers Plasticiser is ideal to add to mortar mixes when appropriate well-graded sands are not available. LANKO® 311 Bricklayers Plasticiser is generically referred to as “liquid ball bearings.”
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. To plasticise mortars, renders and other sand/cement mixes. Allows for easier workability in mortars, particularly those that contain coarse sand. Mortars will flow more readily at lower water contents, and maintain shape and form, even under loads from subsequent layers of bricks. Reduces segregation and bleeding in mortar mixes, therefore reducing unsightly surface laitence. This also improves cure of mortars, leading to a stronger and more durable result. Eliminates the need for lime to plasticise the mix thus allowing the water/cement ratio to be reduced, producing a higher strength mortar. Improves surface adhesion of renders while still wet.
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.5.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. LANKO® 311 Bricklayers Plasticiser
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: Plasticiser additive, for increased workability
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals, certificates and standards stated by the manufacturer. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (May 2026, Version 01.02) has no approvals, certificates or standards section.
2.3 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Greatly improve handling characteristics of mortars
    - Reduces segregation and bleeding
    - High strength
    - Ideal for bricklayer’s mortar and sand/cement mortars
2.4 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Appearance and colour: Clear liquid
2.5 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: 5 L and 20 L
    - Shelf life: 12 months
    - Storage conditions: Product must be stored in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging in dry conditions at temperatures between 4 °C and 35 °C.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (May 2026, Version 01.02) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (May 2026, Version 01.02) and the requirements below.
4.2 Consumption. The following dosage rates are to be taken as a guide only.
    - Job site conditions and raw material variability may leads to adjustments to these figures.
    - Do not add more than the maximum level of LANKO® 311 Bricklayers Plasticiser, as too much air will be entrained leading to a weaker and less durable cured mortar.
    | Dosage | Bricklaying fatty sands | Bricklaying coarse sand |
    | Per 40 kg cement | 25–40 mL | 40–60 mL |
    | Per 200 L water | 300–500 mL | 500–600 mL |
4.3 Mixing.
    - As mixing methods and available materials vary, a trial mix is recommended to determine the dose rate for the best results.
    - LANKO® 311 Bricklayers Plasticiser must be added to the gauging water prior to mixing into the sand/cement mortar. Do not add it directly to the blended mortar.
    - Once LANKO® 311 Bricklayers Plasticiser has been added to the gauging water, proceed with the preparation of the bricklaying or rendering mortar as per usual.
4.4 Cleaning of equipment. Use clean water to clean up excess LANKO® 311 Bricklayers Plasticiser and tools.
4.5 Limitations and important considerations.
    - Precautions should be taken to avoid skin or eye contact or swallowing the product.
    - Do not overdose mortar mixes with LANKO® 311 Bricklayers Plasticiserr as it will weaken the mortar by entraining excessive amounts of air.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions to be verified. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (May 2026, Version 01.02) lists no application condition limits.
5.3 Trials, test areas and compatibility checks stated by the manufacturer.
    - As mixing methods and available materials vary, a trial mix is recommended to determine the dose rate for the best results.
5.4 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.5 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: LANKO® 311 Bricklayers Plasticiser, May 2026, Version 01.02, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/x/lanko-311-bricklayersplasticiser.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS LANKO 311 Bricklayers Plasticiser, version 08/10/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/s/sds-lanko-311-bricklayersplasticiser.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.1, and include the records in the project documentation.
